svg.text: On this machine: SHA-256 is 1.17× to 2.31× faster than BLAKE3; BLAKE3 is 1.77× to 3.94× faster than SHA-1DC; BLAKE3 is faster at 64 B, BLAKE3 SME2 at 1 MiB

Line and dot: median · shaded band: minimum–maximum across 240 interleaved samples · single-threaded · lower is better · hover a dot to compare contenders at that size · click a name at right to hide or show that contender

g.text: BLAKE3 SME2: source https://github.com/johnservil/BLAKE3 · branch sme2-bench · commit 4ca9952c8522 · single-threaded; SME2 kernel for groups of sixteen chunks, integer + NEON hybrid kernels below that; the benchmark stops on a CPU without SME2
BLAKE3: 64 B fits one chunk → portable compression
